summary: Session 2 of 2 (final) verified the Session 1 COM-shutdown hardening against real Microsoft Access and removed the blunt test teardown so the fragile COM/PDF tier stops needing babysitting. Confirmed Access was installed (MSACCESS.EXE App Path + Access.Application ProgID) before running the tier. Ran the full Access-COM/PDF integration tier (AccessHarvester.Integration, 56/56 passed, incl. the report-baseline/PDF surface and the in-process CorePipeline runs) on a Windows+Access host with a before/after process census: msaccess=0 and testhost=0 both PRE and POST every run -- the hardened AccessComSession leaves no orphaned msaccess.exe and no leaked testhost. Simplified tests/AccessHarvester.Integration/TestSupport/CliInvoker.cs: replaced the blunt external `taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F` subprocess with a narrow managed PID-scoped Process.Kill last-resort, and -- now that AccessComSession self-reaps its exact msaccess PID on Dispose -- made the report-baseline path (RunUntilFilesExist) let the CLI exit on its own (bounded 15s) so that self-cleanup runs instead of being blunt-killed mid-teardown (msaccess via COM is a DCOM-activated LocalServer, not in the CLI process tree, so a tree-kill never reaped it anyway). Found and fixed a pre-existing parallel-COM file-lock race the tier run surfaced: ClassifyCommandTests timed out at 240s in the full run but passed in 7s isolated because CanonicalGoldenRegressionTests / EndToEndPipelineTests / ManifestSchemaConformanceTests drive in-process COM against HomeHealthCare.accdb but were not in the serializing [Collection("HomeHealthCareCom")] -- added them per the documented project-guidance fix-forward tactic, making the tier deterministic. Wired docs/access-com-zombie-cleanup.md into durable guidance: a new Testing Convention in project-guidance.md and a test-lane paragraph in the Building & Testing section of CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md (keep-in-sync rule). Lock-file (.laccdb/.ldb) cleanup was a maintainer call and was DEFERRED (force-kill is a rare failsafe; samples open read-only and Access auto-recovers a stale lock; no disposable per-run DBs need recreation). Build 0 errors; hermetic ComProcessReaperTests 9/9; cross-provider VERIFIED round 1 (gpt-5-4, OpenAI). Orchestrated by Claude Code (Opus 4.8) per the human's choice rather than the routed Gemini recommendation -- the gpt-5-4 verification override stayed cross-provider so no override swap was needed.
